selection: Two axial K&J D31 magnet pairs across the clamshell seam, captured by side-loading cups and screwed rear plugs
status: Inert closure trial; holding, printing, strength, magnetic interference and UV containment unqualified

selected_hardware.polarity_instruction: North along dock+Z on both lower and upper discs gives attracting facing poles when closed; verify received poles before capture.
selected_hardware.CAD_basis: Native circle/Pad from actual manufacturer dimensions. Unpublished edge breaks omitted; not a bounding-box proxy.
selected_hardware.OEM_STEP_download_result: Public manufacturer link returned403; no bypass attempted.
selected_hardware.pull_force_limit: Catalog0.75lb value is to a thick steel plate. It is not used as installed holding force across this plastic gap.

selected_hardware.CAD_basis: Native revolved selected nominal head/major profile. Drive recess, thread helix and undisclosed edge breaks omitted. Manufacturer torque is not accepted torque in printed plastic.

visible_grip.nominal_vertical_overlap_below_base_seam: Central4.5mm; extreme rounded sides1.5mm. Separate rear baffle lip provides3mm nominal overlap.
visible_grip.finish: Cream face/visible grip; orange upper shell and dark lower shell. Use a cream finish zone if the upper cup is integrated into a single printed lid.

rear_retention.retainer: Rear plug and offset liner baffle form one printed part per shell; no extra product print parts

loading.magnets: Before rear plugs and device: slide flat discs from+Y toward−Y through each5.05x1.8 channel, seat atY−3; do not force or press-fit.
loading.plugs: Insert shaped rear plug from+Y after magnets. Its concave fingers close the side-loading paths, then install the selected screw.
loading.driver: 1.5mm hex; nominal Ø4.6x18mm rear approach. Lower axisX0/Z34.8,Y6.3..24.3; upperX0/Z42,Y8..26. Complete actual tool fit and whole-dock access remain unqualified.
loading.process: Print, clean and qualify pilot/tap on actual MJF or engineering SLA coupon. Candidate pilot-end allowance1.2mm includes tap/runout study; it is not a qualified tap/tool profile.

motion.released_definition: Geometrically opened reference; no magnet force/release threshold is predicted.
motion.not_proved: Continuous swept clearance, manufactured tolerances, holding force, UV leakage and transport retention

integration.API: add_catch(shellBody,side); add_liner_clearance(linerBody,side); build_retainer/build_magnet/build_screw into the matching moving group. Cropped shell/liner coupons are test context only.
integration.coupon_context: Exact front wall BReps cropped read-only from the saved master. Clipping boxes define the coupon bounds and are not assembly fit models.
integration.master_to_product: Do not import cropped coupon walls into the master. Apply the actual native features or reconstruct them on the owned shell bodies.
integration.root_owns: Whole-shell integration, cream finish, original LatchCover removal, final seam/driver/device/UV checks and any physical release.

liner_counterparts.sequence: Integral cups exist first. Install relieved lower liner vertically down and upper liner vertically up BEFORE magnets/rear plugs/baffles. Install magnet discs, then combined plug/baffles and their screws, then device/obstructing hardware.
liner_counterparts.UV_qualification: Geometric offset/overlap only; whole opaque seam, material aging and measured optical leakage remain unqualified.
